candidats.titre: File:Church of St Mary Magdalen Laver Essex England - William Cole High Sheriff of Essex tomb plinth.jpg
candidats.description: The tomb chest of William Cole (c.1669-1729), against the south wall of the nave to the west of the porch of the Church of St Mary Magdalen at Magdalen Laver , Essex , England. The tomb is set on three stone steps, contains a central fascia plaque with cherubs either side standing on memento mori. Above the gadrooned-edge slab is a carved coat of arms finial. William Cole was High Sheriff of Essex in 1716, and was treasurer of St Thomas' Hospital , originally in Southwark in London. Camera : Canon EOS 6D with Canon EF 24-105mm F4L IS USM lens. Software : large RAW file lens-corrected, optimize
